## Fixed
- Flicking the video back up while dragging it down now keeps the player open
- Letting go of the player after holding it still no longer throws it to the mini player
- Player swipe distances now feel the same on every screen density
- Dragging out of landscape fullscreen no longer jumps back to the middle while the screen turns
- The tilt sensor is no longer kept on while the mini player is showing
- Leaving picture in picture with the phone held sideways no longer leaves the player stuck in fullscreen
- Brightness and volume readouts no longer vanish halfway through a quick second swipe
